info.title: CrowdSieve API
info.description: CrowdSec CAPI filtering proxy — internal management API + signals passthrough.

get.summary: Liveness probe
get.description: Returns the proxy status and current server timestamp.

get.summary: List the filter rules and the filter mode

anyOf.description: Name of the file the rule was loaded from

get.summary: Count the stored alerts matched by each filter rule
get.description: Counts alerts by the rule names saved when they were stored. Local audit rows and alerts stored before rule names were saved count under no rule.

post.summary: Test the current filter rules on a stored alert
post.description: Runs the loaded rules on the payload stored with the alert and tells whether it would be filtered. Read-only: nothing is stored or forwarded.

post.summary: Send a test message to a notification target
post.description: Delivers "CrowdSieve test notification from <dashboard_url>" once, without retry. A delivery failure is answered with 200 and ok=false.

post.summary: Forward CrowdSec signals to CAPI after filtering
post.description: Receives a batch of CrowdSec alerts, runs them through the configured filters, stores them locally, replicates relevant decisions to LAPI servers, and forwards non-filtered, non-loop alerts to the upstream CAPI.
